metadata.description: LeanCode's Claude Code plugins for Flutter development.

plugins.name: lean-core
plugins.description: Entry point for the LeanCode AI plugins marketplace. Explains what's available and helps contributors open PRs to add or improve plugins.

plugins.name: flutter-localization
plugins.description: LeanCode Flutter localization guidance for ARB, POEditor, and l10n(context) workflows.

plugins.name: flutter-leancode-architecture
plugins.description: LeanCode Flutter architecture standards for project structure, error handling, and logging.

plugins.name: flutter-di
plugins.description: LeanCode Flutter dependency injection guidance using the provider package (page-scoped and global providers, AsyncLoader).

plugins.name: flutter-navigation
plugins.description: LeanCode Flutter navigation guidance for auto_route and go_router with typed routes, route organization, guards, shells, and deep links.

plugins.name: flutter-analytics
plugins.description: LeanCode Flutter analytics guidance for feature-level IDs, page tracking, clickable elements, and analytics review/scaffolding workflows.

plugins.name: flutter-bloc
plugins.description: LeanCode Flutter BLoC guidance for state management, cubit patterns, and presentation side effects.

plugins.name: flutter-cubit-utils
plugins.description: LeanCode cubit-utils base classes (QueryCubit, PaginatedQueryCubit, RequestCubit) and canonical cubit recipes for lists, details, and actions.

plugins.name: flutter-forms
plugins.description: LeanCode Flutter forms guidance based on leancode_forms, form cubits, and validation behavior.

plugins.name: flutter-cqrs
plugins.description: LeanCode Flutter CQRS guidance for contracts, data-access patterns, and client-side command/query usage.

plugins.name: flutter-ui
plugins.description: LeanCode Flutter UI guidance for Figma-driven implementation and design-system usage.

plugins.name: flutter-patrol
plugins.description: LeanCode Patrol E2E testing guidance (Modules/System/ApiClients, keys conventions) plus Patrol MCP setup for AI-assisted test development.

plugins.name: flutter-marionette
plugins.description: LeanCode Marionette MCP setup and usage — runtime interaction with a live Flutter debug app for AI-driven exploration, smoke verification, and UI debugging.

plugins.name: flutter-read-logs
plugins.description: Read the running Flutter app's latest run logs as on-demand context — inspect what a flutter run already produced (incl. build errors and crashes), no live connection or instrumentation, via /read-logs.

plugins.name: lean-interactive-html
plugins.description: Generate single-file interactive HTML reports, dashboards, plans, architecture diagrams, and decision forms — self-contained, no CDN, no build step, via /interactive-html.
